offer.text: An arrow flies no straighter than its feathers. Bring me 16 and I'll keep my quiver true.

accept.text: Chase down a few birds for me. I'll wait at the range.

decline.text: Crooked arrows, crooked shots. A shame.

ready.text: Sixteen fine feathers — every shaft will sing now.

complete.text: You keep my aim honest. I won't forget it.
